name: PDF Editor & Viewer
description: Open the complete PdfCraft PDF workspace: view, annotate, organize, fill forms and recognize scanned text locally.
note: The full editor loads separately. OCR is memory intensive; use a desktop for large scans. Powered by PdfCraft, with its upstream notices retained.

name: Reverse PDF Pages
description: Reverse the page order without rasterizing the document.

name: Add Blank PDF Page
description: Insert a blank page before or after a chosen page.

name: Flatten PDF Forms
description: Turn filled form appearances into fixed page content.
note: Existing digital signatures become invalid after changes. This does not remove all annotations.

name: Fill PDF Forms
description: Fill text, checkbox and choice fields using their field names.
note: Only supported AcroForm fields are filled. XFA forms are unsupported. Fonts outside the built-in Latin font may need an embedded font.

name: Remove PDF Metadata
description: Remove standard document information and XMP metadata.
note: This is metadata cleanup, not document redaction or removal of content inside pages.

name: Crop PDF
description: Set visible page margins in PDF points.
note: Cropping changes the visible page box. Hidden content remains in the file.

name: Resize PDF Pages
description: Fit pages inside A4 or Letter sheets while preserving aspect ratio.

name: N-Up PDF
description: Place two or four source pages on each landscape sheet.

name: PDF Booklet
description: Arrange pages for a folded, left-to-right booklet.
note: Pads to a multiple of four pages. Print duplex, flip on the short edge; test a small batch first.

name: Alternate Merge PDF
description: Interleave two PDFs, then append any remaining pages.
note: Choose exactly two PDF files in front/back order.

name: Add Text to PDF
description: Add a text annotation to selected pages at a chosen position.
note: Adds new text; it does not edit or replace existing page text. Built-in font supports Latin text.

name: PDF to JSON
description: Export page text, coordinates and dimensions as JSON.
note: Uses the existing text layer. Scanned pages need OCR first.

name: PDF to Word
description: Export editable paragraphs, images and tables, or choose a page-image Word copy.
note: Editable mode reconstructs headings, paragraphs, tables and images; formatting and pagination can change. Page-image mode contains page pictures, so its text is not editable. OCR can make mistakes; review important documents.

name: PDF to Excel
description: Extract detected tables into an XLSX workbook.
note: Text-based tables work best. Borderless or scanned tables may need review or OCR.

name: PDF to CSV
description: Save detected PDF tables as separate CSV files in a ZIP archive.
note: No table is invented when extraction finds none. Scanned tables need OCR or a layout model.

name: PDF to HTML
description: Export semantic HTML with headings, tables and images in a complete ZIP package.
note: Uses DocVortex 0.6.24. Unzip the package before opening document.html so relative image assets load. This is semantic HTML; original page layout is not guaranteed.

name: PDF to PowerPoint
description: Place each rendered PDF page on a separate PowerPoint slide.
note: Slides contain page images. Individual text and shapes are not editable.

name: PDF to TIFF
description: Render pages into a multipage TIFF image.

name: PDF to SVG
description: Export pages as SVG files through Poppler.

name: Extract PDF Images
description: Download embedded page images in a ZIP archive.

name: Extract PDF Attachments
description: Save document attachments into a ZIP archive.
note: Attachments are untrusted files. Downloading does not execute them.

name: PDF Bookmarks to JSON
description: Export the document outline and destination page numbers.

name: Remove PDF Annotations
description: Remove page annotations while keeping page content.
note: Comments, links and widgets can be removed. Review the result because form widgets are annotations.

name: Repair PDF
description: Rebuild the cross-reference structure of a readable PDF.
note: Recovery is best effort. Missing or damaged page content cannot always be recovered.

name: Protect PDF
description: Encrypt a PDF using AES-256 and a password.
note: Keep the password safely. Changes invalidate existing digital signatures.

name: Unlock PDF
description: Remove encryption using the document password you supply.
note: A valid password is required for encrypted documents. This tool does not crack passwords.

name: Rasterize PDF
description: Rebuild each PDF page as an image-only page.
note: Removes selectable text, forms, links, tags and signatures. Review visual quality and keep the original.

name: PDF to Grayscale
description: Rebuild each page as a grayscale image.
note: Rasterized output loses searchable text and interactive content.

name: Compare PDF Files
description: Render two PDFs and download a page-by-page visual difference report.
note: Compares pixels at 96 DPI, not legal meaning or edit history. Choose exactly two PDFs.

name: OCR PDF
description: Add a searchable text layer to scanned PDF pages.
note: OCR can misread names, numbers, handwriting and tables. Review important text.

name: Image to Text
description: Recognize text in a PNG, JPG or TIFF image with Tesseract.

name: Linearize PDF
description: Optimize a PDF for progressive web viewing with qpdf.

name: Compress PDF — Server
description: Recompress PDF images through Ghostscript.
note: Defaults to the higher-quality prepress profile. Smaller presets trade image detail for size; already optimized PDFs may not become smaller.

name: Validate PDF
description: Inspect PDF structure using pdfcpu.
note: Structural validation is not PDF/A, PDF/UA or digital signature certification.

name: Optimize PDF
description: Optimize a PDF with pdfcpu without intentionally reducing image quality.

name: Word to PDF
description: Convert Word documents to PDF with LibreOffice through Gotenberg.
note: Uses lossless image export and an expanded open-font set. Missing custom fonts or unsupported Office features can still change layout. Linked images must be embedded in the original document.

name: Excel to PDF
description: Convert Excel documents to PDF with LibreOffice through Gotenberg.
note: Uses lossless image export and an expanded open-font set. Missing custom fonts or unsupported Office features can still change layout. Linked images must be embedded in the original document.

name: PowerPoint to PDF

note: Uses lossless image export and an expanded open-font set. Missing custom fonts or unsupported Office features can still change layout. Linked images must be embedded in the original document.

name: ODT to PDF

note: Uses lossless image export and an expanded open-font set. Missing custom fonts or unsupported Office features can still change layout. Linked images must be embedded in the original document.

name: RTF to PDF

note: Uses lossless image export and an expanded open-font set. Missing custom fonts or unsupported Office features can still change layout. Linked images must be embedded in the original document.

note: Uses lossless image export and an expanded open-font set. Missing custom fonts or unsupported Office features can still change layout. Linked images must be embedded in the original document.

name: ODP to PDF
description: Convert ODP documents to PDF with LibreOffice through Gotenberg.
note: Uses lossless image export and an expanded open-font set. Missing custom fonts or unsupported Office features can still change layout. Linked images must be embedded in the original document.

name: Office to PDF
description: Convert Office documents to PDF with LibreOffice through Gotenberg.
note: Uses lossless image export and an expanded open-font set. Missing custom fonts or unsupported Office features can still change layout. Linked images must be embedded in the original document.

name: HTML to PDF
description: Print an uploaded HTML file to PDF through Chromium.
note: Scripts and outbound network access are disabled in the supplied container configuration.

name: PDF to PDF/A
description: Remediate a PDF into an archival profile using Gotenberg.
note: Check conformance independently for regulated archiving. Conversion can change fonts or appearance.

name: Document to Markdown — Docling
description: Extract document structure, reading order and tables with Docling.
note: Runs a self-hosted layout model. Model files download separately; inspect reconstructed tables and formulas.

name: Document to JSON — Docling
description: Extract document structure, reading order and tables with Docling.
note: Runs a self-hosted layout model. Model files download separately; inspect reconstructed tables and formulas.

name: Document to HTML — Docling
description: Extract document structure, reading order and tables with Docling.
note: Runs a self-hosted layout model. Model files download separately; inspect reconstructed tables and formulas.

name: Scanned PDF to Word — PaddleOCR
description: Recognize layout and export a DOCX with PP-StructureV3.
note: PaddleOCR 3.7.0 PP-StructureV3 recognizes layout and scanned text. It may return one DOCX per page in a ZIP. OCR and reconstruction require review.

name: PDF to Markdown — MinerU
description: Parse complex PDF layouts with a self-hosted MinerU engine.
note: MinerU 4.2.3 local Flash produces a ZIP with Markdown, structured JSON and image assets. It requires the optional worker and operator acceptance of its code/model terms; no hosted API is used.

name: PDF to JSON — MinerU
description: Parse complex PDF layouts with a self-hosted MinerU engine.
note: MinerU 4.2.3 local Flash produces a ZIP with Markdown, structured JSON and image assets. It requires the optional worker and operator acceptance of its code/model terms; no hosted API is used.

name: PDF to Markdown — Marker
description: Extract structured document content with a local Marker model.
note: Marker 2.2.0 local fast mode. Optional model installation and model-license eligibility are required. No hosted LLM enhancement is used.

name: PDF to JSON — Marker
description: Extract structured document content with a local Marker model.
note: Marker 2.2.0 local fast mode. Optional model installation and model-license eligibility are required. No hosted LLM enhancement is used.

name: PDF to HTML — Marker
description: Extract structured document content with a local Marker model.
note: Marker 2.2.0 local fast mode. Optional model installation and model-license eligibility are required. No hosted LLM enhancement is used.

name: Universal File Converter — Filee
description: Use the installed Filee engine to convert supported document, image, media or ebook formats.
note: Available format pairs depend on the installed Filee version and optional engines. Unsupported pairs return an error.

name: Office Converter — GenOffice
description: Convert supported Office and PDF formats with the installed GenOffice CLI.
note: Uses local conversion only. AI, account-linked and cloud commands are excluded.

name: PDF to Word — Geometric Layout
description: Try an alternative editable DOCX reconstruction that follows page geometry.
note: Uses the optional pdf2docx 0.5.13 / PyMuPDF 1.26.7 worker. Fonts, tables and layout can still differ; it is not a lossless converter. Requires deployment and operator review of AGPL/commercial dependency terms. Scans need OCR first.
